title: Color lab
subtitle: The default product shell is cool gray. These four directions only retune color tokens. Layout stays the same.
diagnosisBody: The default Codex Neutral theme paints canvas, rail, and primary actions in the same gray scale. Brand aou is a muted blue-gray, and the teal already defined in the visual system never reaches the default theme.
applyHint: This is a prototype. If one direction feels right, we can turn it into a Display Settings theme without changing layout.

shell.approvalBody: Group overdue items by owner and mark the first one open.

messages.user: List overdue tasks in the requirements workspace.
messages.assistant: Three items are past due. I grouped them by owner and opened the first one.

now.name: Now
now.pitch: Cool gray canvas, gray rail, black primary. The current default.
now.fit: Baseline. Keep only if you want coding-IDE neutrality.

forest.name: Forest
forest.pitch: Green-tinted surfaces, deep rail, teal accent already in the visual system.
forest.fit: Lowest risk. Finishes tokens the app already defines.

cobalt.name: Cobalt
cobalt.pitch: Warm paper canvas with a clear blue action color. Same product identity, less gray.
cobalt.fit: Conservative. Closest to today's blue buttons.

inkTan.name: Ink Tan
inkTan.pitch: Near-black rail against a warm paper work surface. Rust for actions.
inkTan.fit: Highest contrast. The least gray of the four.

olive.name: Olive
olive.pitch: Olive-tinted surfaces with a brick action color. Quieter than rust, warmer than gray.
olive.fit: Distinctive. Use if Forest and Cobalt still feel too close to now.
